gloss: written record (of a statement or inquiry)

definitions.gloss: written record of a statement or investigation (by police, prosecutors, or a court)
definitions.explanation: An official document recording what a suspect, witness or other party said under questioning, or the results of an investigation. Common in crime reporting and legal dramas.
